title: 先在地上看一遍
description: 两位成人站在垫区外观察低墙一条大把手路线。

art_direction.medium: clean cel-shaded sports animation with crisp anatomy and soft environmental light
art_direction.scene: Two fictional adults stand outside the padded landing boundary and look at a short low wall route made of large blue rounded holds. The nearer adult loosely points to an obvious start with an open hand, while the other follows the gaze. No one is climbing, and the full route remains visible in one landscape frame. Include broad footholds, a clear easy descent path, and no printed route grades or signs. Use a handmade clay-diorama illustration with modeled fictional adult figures, tactile walls, soft studio light, and warm terracotta and mint. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
